# Prepare input tables

```{r prepare-inputs}
# Prepare U.S.-SDRI input tables

# ============================================================
# SECTION 1. PACKAGES, PATHS, AND ANALYSIS SETTINGS
# ============================================================
required_packages <- c('data.table', 'stringr', 'countrycode', 'ggplot2',
                       'ggrepel', 'scales', 'zoo')
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages)) {
  stop('Install the missing packages, then rerun from the top: install.packages(c(',
       paste(sprintf('"%s"', missing_packages), collapse = ', '), '))')
}
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(countrycode)

analysis_start_year <- 2009L
analysis_end_year <- 2023L
source_profile_year <- analysis_end_year
scenario_year <- analysis_end_year
scenario_reallocation_fraction <- 0.10
scenario_species <- c('tilapia', 'lobster', 'tuna', 'sablefish')
figure_dpi <- 600L

primary_exporter_metric <- 'ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness'
secondary_exporter_metric <- 'ndgain_vulnerability'
combined_ndgain_weights <- c(vulnerability = 0.5, readiness_risk = 0.5)
normalization_population <- 'core_and_extended'

if (length(analysis_start_year) != 1L || length(analysis_end_year) != 1L ||
    !is.finite(analysis_start_year) || !is.finite(analysis_end_year) ||
    analysis_start_year != as.integer(analysis_start_year) ||
    analysis_end_year != as.integer(analysis_end_year) ||
    analysis_start_year > analysis_end_year) {
  stop('Set a single integer start year and end year, with start <= end.')
}
analysis_years <- seq.int(analysis_start_year, analysis_end_year)
if (!source_profile_year %in% analysis_years || !scenario_year %in% analysis_years) {
  stop('source_profile_year and scenario_year must lie within the selected analysis period.')
}
if (!is.finite(scenario_reallocation_fraction) || scenario_reallocation_fraction <= 0 ||
    scenario_reallocation_fraction >= 1) {
  stop('scenario_reallocation_fraction must be strictly between zero and one.')
}

project_dir <- normalizePath('.', winslash = '/', mustWork = TRUE)
data_dir <- file.path(project_dir, 'data_raw')
processed_dir <- file.path(project_dir, 'data_processed')
results_table_dir <- file.path(project_dir, 'outputs', 'results_tables')
results_figure_dir <- file.path(project_dir, 'outputs', 'results_figures')
internal_dir <- file.path(project_dir, '_revision_internal')
diagnostics_dir <- file.path(internal_dir, 'diagnostics')
source_profile_checks_dir <- file.path(internal_dir, 'source_profile_checks')
scenario_checks_dir <- file.path(internal_dir, 'scenario_checks')
ranking_checks_dir <- file.path(internal_dir, 'ranking_checks')

for (p in c(processed_dir, results_table_dir, results_figure_dir, diagnostics_dir,
            source_profile_checks_dir, scenario_checks_dir, ranking_checks_dir)) {
  dir.create(p, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

trade_files <- sort(list.files(
  path = data_dir,
  pattern = '^ANNUAL TRADE-YEAR-PRODUCT-COUNTRY.*\\.csv$',
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
))
landings_file <- file.path(data_dir, 'FOSS_landings.csv')
ndgain_vulnerability_file <- file.path(data_dir, 'ndgain_countryindex_2026',
                                      'vulnerability', 'vulnerability.csv')
ndgain_readiness_file <- file.path(data_dir, 'ndgain_countryindex_2026',
                                  'readiness', 'readiness.csv')
required_inputs <- c(trade_files, landings_file, ndgain_vulnerability_file,
                     ndgain_readiness_file)
if (!length(trade_files) || any(!file.exists(required_inputs))) {
  stop('Missing raw inputs. Check the data_raw/ layout and the file settings in Section 1.')
}

input_manifest <- data.table(
  file = substring(required_inputs, nchar(project_dir) + 2L),
  bytes = file.info(required_inputs)$size,
  md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(required_inputs))
)
fwrite(input_manifest, file.path(diagnostics_dir, 'input_manifest.csv'))

run_settings <- data.table(
  setting = c('analysis_start_year', 'analysis_end_year', 'source_profile_year',
              'scenario_year', 'scenario_reallocation_fraction',
              'normalization_population', 'primary_exporter_metric',
              'secondary_exporter_metric', 'landings_join', 'coverage_period'),
  value = as.character(c(analysis_start_year, analysis_end_year, source_profile_year,
                         scenario_year, scenario_reallocation_fraction,
                         normalization_population, primary_exporter_metric,
                         secondary_exporter_metric,
                         'unique common-name/group lookup',
                         'selected analysis years')))
fwrite(run_settings, file.path(diagnostics_dir, 'run_settings.csv'))

# ============================================================
# SECTION 2. FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================

to_snake <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(x)
  x <- gsub('[^a-z0-9]+', '_', x)
  x <- gsub('^_|_$', '', x)
  x
}

num_clean <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x == ''] <- NA_character_
  as.numeric(gsub(',', '', x))
}

txt_clean <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  str_squish(x)
}

minmax01 <- function(x) {
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(rng[1]) || !is.finite(rng[2]) || rng[1] == rng[2]) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  }
  (x - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1])
}

validate_exporter_metric <- function(x) {
  allowed <- c('ndgain_vulnerability', 'ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness')
  if (!x %in% allowed) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Invalid exporter metric '", x, "'. Valid options are: ",
        paste(allowed, collapse = ', ')
      )
    )
  }
  x
}

validate_exporter_metric(primary_exporter_metric)
validate_exporter_metric(secondary_exporter_metric)
if (abs(sum(combined_ndgain_weights) - 1) > 1e-9) {
  stop('combined_ndgain_weights must sum to 1.')
}

check_columns <- function(dt, cols, label) {
  absent <- setdiff(cols, names(dt))
  if (length(absent)) stop(label, ' is missing columns: ', paste(absent, collapse = ', '))
}
assert_unique <- function(dt, key_cols, label) {
  dup <- dt[, .N, by = key_cols][N > 1L]
  if (nrow(dup)) {
    fwrite(dup, file.path(diagnostics_dir,
                          paste0('ERROR_duplicate_', gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9]+', '_', label), '.csv')))
    stop(label, ' has duplicate keys; see the ERROR diagnostic. No arbitrary row was chosen.')
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}
mean_finite <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x)) mean(x) else NA_real_
}
max_abs_finite <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x)) max(abs(x)) else NA_real_
}
safe_ratio <- function(a, b) {
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(a))
  ok <- is.finite(a) & is.finite(b) & b > 0
  out[ok] <- a[ok] / b[ok]
  out
}
check_source_years <- function(years, label) {
  data.table(source = label, requested_year = analysis_years,
             present = analysis_years %in% unique(years[!is.na(years)]))
}

# ============================================================
# SECTION 3. IMPORT AND CLEAN NOAA TRADE DATA
# ============================================================
if (length(trade_files) == 0) {
  stop('No trade files found. Check the working directory and filename pattern.')
}

annual_raw <- rbindlist(lapply(trade_files, function(f) fread(f, skip = 1)), fill = TRUE)
setDT(annual_raw)
trade_raw_n_before <- nrow(annual_raw)
annual_raw <- unique(annual_raw)
trade_exact_duplicates_removed <- trade_raw_n_before - nrow(annual_raw)

annual_trade_clean <- copy(annual_raw)
setnames(annual_trade_clean, to_snake(names(annual_trade_clean)))
check_columns(annual_trade_clean, c('year','source','product_name','country_name',
                                   'volume_kg','value_usd','edible_code'), 'NOAA trade data')
if (!'calculated_duty_usd' %in% names(annual_trade_clean)) {
  annual_trade_clean[, calculated_duty_usd := NA_real_]
}

annual_trade_clean[, year := as.integer(year)]
annual_trade_clean[, source := txt_clean(source)]
annual_trade_clean[, product_name := txt_clean(product_name)]
annual_trade_clean[, country_name := txt_clean(country_name)]
annual_trade_clean[, edible_code := txt_clean(edible_code)]

annual_trade_clean[, volume_kg := num_clean(volume_kg)]
annual_trade_clean[, value_usd := num_clean(value_usd)]
annual_trade_clean[, calculated_duty_usd := num_clean(calculated_duty_usd)]

annual_trade_clean[source %chin% c('IMPORT', 'IMPORTS', 'IMP'), source := 'IMP']
annual_trade_clean[source %chin% c('EXPORT', 'EXPORTS', 'EXP'), source := 'EXP']
annual_trade_clean[source %chin% c('RE-EXPORT', 'RE-EXPORTS', 'REEXPORT', 'REEXPORTS', 'REX'), source := 'REX']

annual_trade_clean[, trade_flow := fcase(
  source == 'IMP', 'imports',
  source == 'EXP', 'exports',
  source == 'REX', 're_exports',
  default = 'other'
)]

annual_trade_clean[, edible_main := edible_code == 'E']
annual_trade_clean[, unit_value_usd_per_kg := fifelse(!is.na(volume_kg) & volume_kg > 0, value_usd / volume_kg, NA_real_)]
annual_trade_clean[, vintage_flag := fifelse(year < 1975, 'pre_1975_check', 'core_period')]

trade_missing_numeric <- annual_trade_clean[
  year %in% analysis_years,
  .(n_rows = .N, n_missing_volume = sum(is.na(volume_kg)),
    n_missing_value = sum(is.na(value_usd))), by = .(year, source, edible_code)
]
fwrite(trade_missing_numeric, file.path(diagnostics_dir, 'trade_missing_numeric.csv'))
if (annual_trade_clean[year %in% analysis_years, any(volume_kg < 0, na.rm = TRUE)]) {
  stop('Negative trade volumes found in the selected years; investigate before index construction.')
}

trade_key <- c('year', 'source', 'product_name', 'country_name', 'edible_code')

annual_trade_clean <- annual_trade_clean[
  ,
  .(
    volume_kg = sum(volume_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
    value_usd = sum(value_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    calculated_duty_usd = sum(calculated_duty_usd, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = trade_key
]

annual_trade_clean[, trade_flow := fcase(
  source == 'IMP', 'imports',
  source == 'EXP', 'exports',
  source == 'REX', 're_exports',
  default = 'other'
)]
annual_trade_clean[, edible_main := edible_code == 'E']
annual_trade_clean[, unit_value_usd_per_kg := fifelse(!is.na(volume_kg) & volume_kg > 0, value_usd / volume_kg, NA_real_)]
annual_trade_clean[, vintage_flag := fifelse(year < 1975, 'pre_1975_check', 'core_period')]

product_master <- annual_trade_clean[
  ,
  .(
    first_year = min(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_year = max(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_years = uniqueN(year),
    total_volume_kg = sum(volume_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_value_usd = sum(value_usd, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = .(product_name, edible_code)
][order(-total_value_usd)]

country_crosswalk <- unique(annual_trade_clean[, .(country_name)])


custom_matches <- c( 'VIET NAM' = 'VNM', 'TAIWAN' = 'TWN', 'KOREA, SOUTH' = 'KOR', 'SOUTH KOREA' = 'KOR', 'KOREA REPUBLIC OF' = 'KOR', 'KOREA, NORTH' = 'PRK', 'NORTH KOREA' = 'PRK', 'RUSSIA' = 'RUS', 'RUSSIAN FEDERATION' = 'RUS', 'CHINA - HONG KONG' = 'HKG', 'HONG KONG' = 'HKG', 'YEMEN (ADEN)' = 'YEM', 'BR.INDIAN OCEAN TER.' = 'IOT', 'FED STATES OF MICRON' = 'FSM' , 'KOSOVO' = 'XKX', 'GERMANY (EAST)' = 'DEU')

country_crosswalk[, iso3c := countrycode( country_name, origin = 'country.name', destination = 'iso3c', custom_match = custom_matches, warn = TRUE )]

country_crosswalk_unmatched <- country_crosswalk[is.na(iso3c)][order(country_name)]

assert_unique(country_crosswalk, 'country_name', 'country_crosswalk')
annual_trade_clean <- merge(annual_trade_clean, country_crosswalk, by = 'country_name', all.x = TRUE)

annual_trade_clean[, product_form := fcase(
  grepl('CANNED|ATC|FOIL|POUCH', product_name), 'canned_packaged',
  grepl('FILLET', product_name), 'fillet',
  grepl('FRESH|LIVE', product_name), 'fresh_live',
  grepl('FROZEN', product_name), 'frozen',
  grepl('SURIMI', product_name), 'surimi',
  grepl('ROE', product_name), 'roe',
  grepl('MEAL|OIL', product_name), 'meal_oil',
  grepl('PASTE|PASTES|SAUCE|PREPARATION|BREADED|PREPARED', product_name), 'prepared_other',
  default = 'other'
)]

# ============================================================
# SECTION 4. IMPORT AND CLEAN DOMESTIC LANDINGS DATA
# ============================================================
domestic_landing <- fread(landings_file, skip = 1)
setDT(domestic_landing)

domestic_landing_clean <- copy(domestic_landing)
if (ncol(domestic_landing_clean) != 11L) {
  stop('FOSS_landings.csv no longer has the expected 11 columns; review its schema.')
}
setnames(
  domestic_landing_clean,
  old = names(domestic_landing_clean),
  new = c('year','state','nmfs_name','pounds','metric_tons','dollars',
          'confidentiality','collection','scientific_name','tsn','source')
)

domestic_landing_clean[, year := as.integer(year)]
domestic_landing_clean[, state := txt_clean(state)]
domestic_landing_clean[, nmfs_name := txt_clean(nmfs_name)]
domestic_landing_clean[, scientific_name := txt_clean(scientific_name)]
domestic_landing_clean[, confidentiality := txt_clean(confidentiality)]
domestic_landing_clean[, collection := txt_clean(collection)]
domestic_landing_clean[, source := txt_clean(source)]

domestic_landing_clean[, pounds := num_clean(pounds)]
domestic_landing_clean[, metric_tons := num_clean(metric_tons)]
domestic_landing_clean[, dollars := num_clean(dollars)]

domestic_landing_clean <- domestic_landing_clean[collection == 'COMMERCIAL']

fwrite(domestic_landing_clean[year %in% analysis_years,
  .(n_rows = .N, n_missing_pounds = sum(is.na(pounds)),
    n_missing_dollars = sum(is.na(dollars))), by = .(year, confidentiality)],
  file.path(diagnostics_dir, 'landings_missing_numeric.csv'))

negative_landings_raw <- domestic_landing_clean[
  year %in% analysis_years &
    ((!is.na(pounds) & pounds < 0) |
     (!is.na(metric_tons) & metric_tons < 0) |
     (!is.na(dollars) & dollars < 0))
]
fwrite(
  negative_landings_raw,
  file.path(diagnostics_dir, 'landings_negative_raw_records.csv')
)
fwrite(
  negative_landings_raw[, .(
    n_negative_rows = .N,
    negative_pounds_sum = sum(pounds[pounds < 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    negative_metric_tons_sum = sum(metric_tons[metric_tons < 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    negative_dollars_sum = sum(dollars[dollars < 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  ), by = year],
  file.path(diagnostics_dir, 'landings_negative_raw_summary_by_year.csv')
)
if (nrow(negative_landings_raw) > 0L) {
  cat(
    'Diagnostic note: ', nrow(negative_landings_raw),
    ' source landings rows contain at least one negative numeric value in ',
    analysis_start_year, '-', analysis_end_year,
    '. They are retained as reported and written to diagnostics; ',
    'analytical species-year totals are checked after aggregation.\n',
    sep = ''
  )
}

landing_species_master <- domestic_landing_clean[
  ,
  .(
    first_year = min(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_year = max(year, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_years = uniqueN(year),
    total_pounds = sum(pounds, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_metric_tons = sum(metric_tons, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_dollars = sum(dollars, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = .(nmfs_name, scientific_name)
][order(-total_dollars)]

# ============================================================
# SECTION 5. BUILD TRADE AND LANDINGS CROSSWALKS
# ============================================================
trade_product_crosswalk <- unique(annual_trade_clean[, .(product_name)])
trade_product_crosswalk[, `:=`(
  species_group = NA_character_,
  species_subgroup = NA_character_,
  product_form = NA_character_,
  edible_main = NA,
  include_main_analysis = NA,
  notes = NA_character_
)]
trade_product_crosswalk[, product_name_u := toupper(product_name)]

landing_species_crosswalk <- unique(domestic_landing_clean[, .(nmfs_name, scientific_name)])
landing_species_crosswalk[, `:=`(
  species_group = NA_character_,
  species_subgroup = NA_character_,
  include_main_analysis = NA,
  notes = NA_character_
)]
landing_species_crosswalk[, nmfs_name_u := toupper(nmfs_name)]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# SECTION 6. TRADE PRODUCT CROSSWALK RULES
# ------------------------------------------------------------
trade_product_crosswalk[, species_group := fcase(
  grepl('UNFIT FOR HUMAN CONSUMPTION', product_name_u), 'non_food_other',
  grepl('SPONGE|CORAL|CUTTLEBONE|FISH SCALES|FISH SOUNDS|WAXES|PEARL ESSENCE', product_name_u), 'non_food_other',
  grepl('WHALE|SEAL OIL|MARINE ANIMAL NSPF OIL/FRACTIONS|CETACEA|SIRENIA|PINNIPEDIA|TURTLES|REPTILE', product_name_u), 'non_food_other',
  grepl('SEAWEED|ALGAE|AGAR|CARAGEENAN', product_name_u), 'seaweed_algae',
  grepl('SHRIMP|PRAWN', product_name_u), 'shrimp',
  grepl('SALMON', product_name_u), 'salmon',
  grepl('TUNA', product_name_u), 'tuna',
  grepl('POLLOCK', product_name_u), 'pollock',
  grepl('\\bCOD\\b', product_name_u), 'cod',
  grepl('CRAB', product_name_u), 'crab',
  grepl('LOBSTER', product_name_u), 'lobster',
  grepl('TILAPIA', product_name_u), 'tilapia',
  grepl('PANGASIUS|BASA|SWAI', product_name_u), 'pangasius_basa_swai',
  grepl('CATFISH', product_name_u) & !grepl('PANGASIUS|BASA|SWAI', product_name_u), 'catfish_other',
  grepl('\\bSCALLOP(S)?\\b', product_name_u), 'scallops',
  grepl('\\bOYSTER(S)?\\b', product_name_u), 'oysters',
  grepl('\\bCLAM(S)?\\b', product_name_u), 'clams',
  grepl('MUSSEL', product_name_u), 'mussels',
  grepl('SQUID|OCTOPUS|CUTTLEFISH', product_name_u), 'squid_octopus',
  grepl('HERRING', product_name_u), 'herring',
  grepl('MACKEREL', product_name_u), 'mackerel',
  grepl('HALIBUT', product_name_u), 'halibut',
  grepl('SABLEFISH', product_name_u), 'sablefish',
  grepl('SWORDFISH', product_name_u), 'swordfish',
  grepl('SNAPPER|GROUPER|HIND|SCAMP', product_name_u), 'snapper_grouper',
  grepl('FLOUNDER|SOLE|PLAICE|TURBOT|FLATFISH', product_name_u), 'flatfish',
  grepl('HAKE|HADDOCK|MONKFISH|GOOSEFISH|WOLFFISH|WHITEFISH|OCEAN PERCH|SCORPIONFISH|WHITING|CUSK|LINGCOD|BLUE WHITING|ORANGE ROUGHY', product_name_u), 'other_groundfish',
  grepl('SHARK|DOGFISH|RAYS|SKATES', product_name_u), 'sharks_rays_skates',
  grepl('SARDINE|SARDINELLA|SPRAT|ANCHOVY|MENHADEN|CAPELIN|BONITO|ALEWIVES|EULACHON|BUTTERFISH', product_name_u), 'small_pelagics_other',
  grepl('DOLPHINFISH|WAHOO|OILFISH|ESCOLAR|OPAH|YELLOWTAIL|MULLET', product_name_u), 'large_pelagics_other',
  grepl('SEA BASS|SEABREAM|COBIA|POMPANO|^BASS\\b', product_name_u), 'reef_fish_other',
  grepl('TROUT', product_name_u), 'trout',
  grepl('EELS|SHAD|STURGEON', product_name_u), 'eel_sturgeon_shad',
  grepl('CONCH|ABALONE|SNAIL OTHER THAN SEA SNAIL|WHELK|COCKLES|ARK SHELLS|FROG|JELLYFISH', product_name_u), 'other_shellfish_specialty',
  grepl('SEA CUCUMBER|SEA CUCUMBERS|URCHIN|KRILL ANTARCTIC$', product_name_u), 'sea_cucumber_urchin_other_inverts',
  grepl('TOOTHFISH', product_name_u), 'toothfish',
  grepl('PERCH|PIKE|PICKEREL|SMELTS|CARP|SAUGER', product_name_u), 'inland_freshwater_other',
  grepl('CRAWFISH FRESHWATER', product_name_u), 'crawfish_freshwater',
  grepl('MISC|NSPF PRODUCTS PREPARED DINNERS CONTAIN FISH', product_name_u), 'mixed_prepared_products',
  grepl('PASTES|SAUCES|SOUPS|BALLS|CAKES|PUDDING|ANTIPASTO|STICKS,TYPE PRODUCTS|JUICE|ANALOG PRODUCT', product_name_u), 'mixed_prepared_products',
  grepl('CAVIAR', product_name_u), 'caviar_misc',
  grepl('FISH MEAL FOR HUMAN CONSUMPTION|FISH OR SHELLFISH MEAL FOR HUMAN CONSUMPTION', product_name_u), 'mixed_prepared_products',
  grepl('FISH GLUE|ISINGLASS|AMBERGRIS|WAX SPERMACETI|SHELLS MARINE CRUDE', product_name_u), 'non_food_other',
  grepl('KRILL .*ANIMAL FEED', product_name_u), 'non_food_other',
  grepl('\\bMOLLUSCS NSPF\\b', product_name_u), 'unidentified_molluscs',
  grepl('\\bCRUSTACEANS NSPF\\b', product_name_u), 'unidentified_crustaceans',
  grepl('\\bSHELLFISH NSPF\\b', product_name_u), 'unidentified_shellfish',
  grepl('\\bMARINE FISH NSPF\\b|\\bFISH NSPF\\b|\\bAQUATIC INVERTEBRATES NSPF\\b|\\bGROUNDFISH NSPF\\b', product_name_u), 'broad_mixed_fish',
  default = 'review'
)]

trade_product_crosswalk[, product_form := fcase(
  grepl('CANNED|ATC|FOIL|POUCH', product_name_u), 'canned_packaged',
  grepl('FILLET', product_name_u), 'fillet',
  grepl('FRESH|LIVE', product_name_u), 'fresh_live',
  grepl('FROZEN', product_name_u), 'frozen',
  grepl('SURIMI', product_name_u), 'surimi',
  grepl('ROE', product_name_u), 'roe',
  grepl('MEAL|OIL', product_name_u), 'meal_oil',
  grepl('PASTE|SAUCE|PREPARATION|BREADED|PREPARED', product_name_u), 'prepared_other',
  default = 'other'
)]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# SECTION 7. LANDINGS CROSSWALK RULES
# ------------------------------------------------------------
landing_species_crosswalk[, species_group := fcase(
  grepl('SHRIMP|PRAWN', nmfs_name_u), 'shrimp',
  grepl('SALMON', nmfs_name_u), 'salmon',
  grepl('TUNA', nmfs_name_u), 'tuna',
  grepl('POLLOCK', nmfs_name_u), 'pollock',
  grepl('\\bCOD\\b', nmfs_name_u), 'cod',
  grepl('\\b(SEA)?TROUTS?\\b', nmfs_name_u), 'trout',
  grepl('CRAB', nmfs_name_u), 'crab',
  grepl('LOBSTER', nmfs_name_u), 'lobster',
  grepl('TILAPIA', nmfs_name_u), 'tilapia',
  grepl('PANGASIUS|BASA|SWAI', nmfs_name_u), 'pangasius_basa_swai',
  grepl('CATFISH', nmfs_name_u) & !grepl('PANGASIUS|BASA|SWAI', nmfs_name_u), 'catfish_other',
  grepl('\\bSCALLOP(S)?\\b', nmfs_name_u), 'scallops',
  grepl('OYSTER', nmfs_name_u), 'oysters',
  grepl('\\bCLAM(S)?\\b', nmfs_name_u), 'clams',
  grepl('MUSSEL', nmfs_name_u), 'mussels',
  grepl('SQUID|OCTOPUS', nmfs_name_u), 'squid_octopus',
  grepl('HERRING', nmfs_name_u), 'herring',
  grepl('MACKEREL', nmfs_name_u), 'mackerel',
  grepl('HALIBUT', nmfs_name_u), 'halibut',
  grepl('SABLEFISH', nmfs_name_u), 'sablefish',
  grepl('SWORDFISH', nmfs_name_u), 'swordfish',
  grepl('SNAPPER|GROUPER|HIND|SCAMP', nmfs_name_u), 'snapper_grouper',
  grepl('FLOUNDER|SOLE|PLAICE|TURBOT', nmfs_name_u), 'flatfish',
  grepl('HAKE|HADDOCK|GOOSEFISH|LINGCOD|ROCKFISH|GREENLING|WOLFFISH|CABEZON|SCORPIONFISH|SCULPINS|THORNYHEAD|TOMCOD|WHITEFISH, OCEAN|GRENADIERS|WOLF-EEL|HAGFISH|PRICKLEBACK|POUT, OCEAN|REDFISH, ACADIAN|SEAROBIN|WINDOWPANE', nmfs_name_u), 'other_groundfish',
  grepl('SHARK|STINGRAY|\\bSKATE(S)?\\b|DOGFISH', nmfs_name_u), 'sharks_rays_skates',
  grepl('ANCHOVY|SARDINE|MENHADEN|CAPELIN|BONITO|ANCHOVIES', nmfs_name_u), 'small_pelagics_other',
  grepl('DOLPHINFISH|WAHOO|OILFISH|LOUVAR|OPAH|ESCOLAR', nmfs_name_u), 'large_pelagics_other',
  grepl('AMBERJACK|JACK,|JACKS|COBIA|POMPANO|LOOKDOWN|RUNNER|RUDDERFISH|SPADEFISH|BIGEYE|BUMPER|CHUB, BERMUDA|PINFISH|SCAD, BIGEYE|POMFRETS|SHEEPHEAD, CALIFORNIA|BASS,|DORY, BUCKLER', nmfs_name_u), 'reef_fish_other',
  grepl('SEA BASS|PORGY|SCUP|SHEEPSHEAD|TAUTOG|CUNNER|TRIGGERFISH|GRUNTS|TILEFISH', nmfs_name_u), 'reef_fish_other',
  grepl('CROAKER|DRUM|KINGFISHES|KINGFISH, NORTHERN|SPOT|BLUEFISH|MULLET|BUTTERFISH|LADYFISH|QUEENFISH|BARRACUDA|TRIPLETAIL|SURFPERCHES|WEAKFISH', nmfs_name_u), 'misc_marine_fish_other',
  grepl('URCHIN|CUCUMBER|ECHINODERM', nmfs_name_u), 'sea_cucumber_urchin_other_inverts',
  grepl('EEL|SHAD|STURGEON|SMELTS', nmfs_name_u), 'eel_sturgeon_shad',
  grepl('CARP|BUFFALOFISH|DRUM, FRESHWATER|YELLOW PERCH|PIKE|BULLHEAD|PERCH, WHITE|PERCH, YELLOW', nmfs_name_u), 'inland_freshwater_other',
  grepl('CONCH|WHELK', nmfs_name_u), 'other_shellfish_specialty',
  grepl('WITHHELD FOR CONFIDENTIALITY', nmfs_name_u), 'withheld_confidentiality',
  grepl('CRUSTACEANS \\*\\*|MOLLUSKS \\*\\*|VERTEBRATES, JAWED|SHARKS, CHONDRICHTHYES|ECHINODERM \\*\\*|ANEMONE|ANGELFISH|BALLOONFISH|BALLYHOOS|BEAUGREGORY|BEAUTY, ROCK|BIGEYES \\*\\*|BISCUIT, INFLATED SEA|BLENNY|BLUEHEAD|BURRFISH|BUTTERFLYFISH|CASSIOPEA|CHERUBFISH|CHITONS|CHROMIS|CORAL|CORALLIMORPH|CORALLINACEAE|COWRIE|CUTLASSFISHES|DAMSELFISH|DOCTORFISH|DRAGONETS|FLAMEFISH', nmfs_name_u), 'exclude_misc_taxa',
  default = 'review'
)]

landing_species_crosswalk[nmfs_name_u == 'HALIBUT, CALIFORNIA', species_group := 'flatfish']
landing_species_crosswalk[grepl('^FLATFISHES', nmfs_name_u), species_group := 'flatfish']

# ============================================================
# SECTION 8. DEFINE CORE, EXTENDED, AND EXCLUDED GROUPS
# ============================================================
core_groups <- c(
  'shrimp','salmon','tuna','pollock','cod','trout','crab','lobster','tilapia',
  'scallops','oysters','clams','mussels','squid_octopus','herring',
  'mackerel','halibut','sablefish','swordfish','snapper_grouper',
  'flatfish','other_groundfish'
)

extended_groups <- c(
  'pangasius_basa_swai','catfish_other','sharks_rays_skates',
  'small_pelagics_other','large_pelagics_other','reef_fish_other',
  'misc_marine_fish_other','eel_sturgeon_shad',
  'other_shellfish_specialty','sea_cucumber_urchin_other_inverts',
  'inland_freshwater_other','toothfish','crawfish_freshwater'
)

exclude_groups_trade <- c(
  'seaweed_algae','non_food_other','mixed_prepared_products',
  'caviar_misc','unidentified_molluscs','unidentified_crustaceans',
  'unidentified_shellfish','broad_mixed_fish'
)

exclude_groups_landings <- c('withheld_confidentiality','exclude_misc_taxa')

trade_product_crosswalk[, include_main_analysis := species_group %in% core_groups]
trade_product_crosswalk[, analysis_tier := fcase(
  species_group %in% core_groups, 'core',
  species_group %in% extended_groups, 'extended',
  species_group %in% exclude_groups_trade, 'exclude',
  default = 'review'
)]
trade_product_crosswalk[, exclude_reason := fcase(
  species_group %in% exclude_groups_trade, species_group,
  default = NA_character_
)]
trade_product_crosswalk[, edible_main := !(
  species_group %in% c('non_food_other','seaweed_algae') |
    !is.na(exclude_reason) |
    grepl('UNFIT FOR HUMAN CONSUMPTION', product_name_u)
)]

landing_species_crosswalk[, include_main_analysis := species_group %in% core_groups]
landing_species_crosswalk[, analysis_tier := fcase(
  species_group %in% core_groups, 'core',
  species_group %in% extended_groups, 'extended',
  species_group %in% exclude_groups_landings, 'exclude',
  default = 'review'
)]

# ============================================================
# SECTION 9. BUILD SPECIES-YEAR TABLES
# ============================================================
assert_unique(trade_product_crosswalk, 'product_name', 'trade_product_crosswalk')
annual_trade_grp_all <- merge(
  annual_trade_clean,
  trade_product_crosswalk[, .(product_name, species_group, analysis_tier)],
  by = 'product_name', all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE
)

landings_lookup <- unique(landing_species_crosswalk[, .(nmfs_name, species_group, analysis_tier)])
assert_unique(landings_lookup, 'nmfs_name', 'landings_common_name_lookup')
landings_lookup_multiplicity <- landing_species_crosswalk[,
  .(original_lookup_rows = .N), by = nmfs_name]
fwrite(landings_lookup_multiplicity[original_lookup_rows > 1L],
       file.path(diagnostics_dir, 'landings_lookup_multiple_scientific_names.csv'))
landings_join_check <- merge(domestic_landing_clean[year %in% analysis_years],
                            landings_lookup_multiplicity, by = 'nmfs_name', all.x = TRUE)
landings_join_check <- merge(landings_join_check, landings_lookup,
                            by = 'nmfs_name', all.x = TRUE)
join_impact <- landings_join_check[, .(
  source_rows = .N,
  rows_under_original_name_only_join = sum(original_lookup_rows),
  retained_pounds = sum(pounds, na.rm = TRUE),
  pounds_under_original_name_only_join = sum(pounds * original_lookup_rows, na.rm = TRUE)
), by = .(year, species_group, analysis_tier)]
join_impact[, excess_pounds_in_original_join :=
             pounds_under_original_name_only_join - retained_pounds]
fwrite(join_impact, file.path(diagnostics_dir, 'landings_join_impact.csv'))
rm(landings_join_check)

domestic_landing_grp_all <- merge(domestic_landing_clean, landings_lookup,
                                 by = 'nmfs_name', all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
stopifnot(nrow(domestic_landing_grp_all) == nrow(domestic_landing_clean))

annual_trade_grp <- annual_trade_grp_all[year %in% analysis_years]
domestic_landing_grp <- domestic_landing_grp_all[year %in% analysis_years]
if (anyNA(annual_trade_grp$analysis_tier) || anyNA(domestic_landing_grp$analysis_tier)) {
  stop('Some source rows have no crosswalk tier. Inspect the mappings before continuing.')
}
fwrite(annual_trade_grp[, .(rows = .N, volume_kg = sum(volume_kg, na.rm = TRUE)),
                        by = .(year, source, trade_flow, edible_code, analysis_tier)],
       file.path(diagnostics_dir, 'trade_flow_and_edible_code_inventory.csv'))
fwrite(annual_trade_grp[analysis_tier %in% c('core','extended') &
                         (is.na(edible_code) | edible_code != 'E'),
  .(rows = .N, volume_kg = sum(volume_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
    value_usd = sum(value_usd, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = .(year, trade_flow, species_group, product_name, edible_code)],
  file.path(diagnostics_dir, 'non_E_records_retained_by_original_rule.csv'))
fwrite(landing_species_crosswalk[species_group == 'trout'],
       file.path(diagnostics_dir, 'trout_crosswalk_current_rules.csv'))

domestic_species_year <- domestic_landing_grp[
  analysis_tier %in% c('core', 'extended'),
  .(
    domestic_pounds = sum(pounds, na.rm = TRUE),
    domestic_kg = sum(pounds, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.45359237,
    domestic_metric_tons = sum(metric_tons, na.rm = TRUE),
    domestic_value_usd = sum(dollars, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = .(year, species_group, analysis_tier)
][order(year, species_group)]

negative_domestic_species_year <- domestic_species_year[
  (!is.na(domestic_pounds) & domestic_pounds < 0) |
    (!is.na(domestic_value_usd) & domestic_value_usd < 0)
]
fwrite(
  negative_domestic_species_year,
  file.path(diagnostics_dir, 'landings_negative_analytical_species_year.csv')
)
if (nrow(negative_domestic_species_year) > 0L) {
  stop(
    'At least one core/extended species-year has a negative aggregated landings ',
    'quantity or value. Inspect diagnostics/landings_negative_analytical_species_year.csv.'
  )
}

trade_country_species_year <- annual_trade_grp[
  trade_flow == 'imports' & analysis_tier %in% c('core', 'extended'),
  .(
    import_volume_kg = sum(volume_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
    import_value_usd = sum(value_usd, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = .(year, iso3c, country_name, species_group, analysis_tier)
][order(year, species_group, -import_value_usd)]

trade_species_year_imports <- annual_trade_grp[
  trade_flow == 'imports' & analysis_tier %in% c('core', 'extended'),
  .(
    import_volume_kg = sum(volume_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
    import_value_usd = sum(value_usd, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = .(year, species_group)
][order(year, species_group)]

trade_species_year_exports <- annual_trade_grp[
  trade_flow == 'exports' & analysis_tier %in% c('core', 'extended'),
  .(
    export_volume_kg = sum(volume_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
    export_value_usd = sum(value_usd, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = .(year, species_group)
][order(year, species_group)]

trade_coverage <- annual_trade_grp[
  trade_flow == 'imports',
  .(
    import_value_usd = sum(value_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    import_volume_kg = sum(volume_kg, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_species_groups = uniqueN(species_group[!is.na(species_group)])
  ),
  by = analysis_tier
][order(-import_value_usd)]
trade_coverage[, value_share := import_value_usd / sum(import_value_usd)]
trade_coverage[, volume_share := import_volume_kg / sum(import_volume_kg)]

domestic_coverage <- domestic_landing_grp[
  ,
  .(
    domestic_value_usd = sum(dollars, na.rm = TRUE),
    domestic_pounds = sum(pounds, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_species_groups = uniqueN(species_group[!is.na(species_group)])
  ),
  by = analysis_tier
][order(-domestic_value_usd)]
domestic_coverage[, value_share := domestic_value_usd / sum(domestic_value_usd)]
domestic_coverage[, pounds_share := domestic_pounds / sum(domestic_pounds)]

trade_groups <- unique(trade_species_year_imports[, .(species_group)])
dom_groups <- unique(domestic_species_year[, .(species_group)])
species_overlap <- merge(trade_groups[, in_trade := TRUE], dom_groups[, in_domestic := TRUE], by = 'species_group', all = TRUE)

# ============================================================
# SECTION 10. IMPORT AND RESHAPE ND-GAIN DATA
# ============================================================
ndgain_vuln <- fread(ndgain_vulnerability_file, header = TRUE)
ndgain_readiness <- fread(ndgain_readiness_file, header = TRUE)

year_cols_vuln <- setdiff(names(ndgain_vuln), c('ISO3', 'Name'))
year_cols_readiness <- setdiff(names(ndgain_readiness), c('ISO3', 'Name'))

ndgain_vuln_long <- melt(
  ndgain_vuln,
  id.vars = c('ISO3', 'Name'),
  measure.vars = year_cols_vuln,
  variable.name = 'year',
  value.name = 'ndgain_vulnerability'
)
ndgain_readiness_long <- melt(
  ndgain_readiness,
  id.vars = c('ISO3', 'Name'),
  measure.vars = year_cols_readiness,
  variable.name = 'year',
  value.name = 'ndgain_readiness'
)

ndgain_vuln_long[, year := as.integer(as.character(year))]
ndgain_readiness_long[, year := as.integer(as.character(year))]

setnames(ndgain_vuln_long, c('ISO3', 'Name'), c('iso3c', 'country_name_ndgain'))
setnames(ndgain_readiness_long, c('ISO3', 'Name'), c('iso3c', 'country_name_ndgain'))

source_year_coverage <- rbindlist(list(
  check_source_years(annual_trade_clean[trade_flow == 'imports', year], 'trade_imports'),
  check_source_years(annual_trade_clean[trade_flow == 'exports', year], 'trade_exports'),
  check_source_years(domestic_landing_clean$year, 'commercial_landings'),
  check_source_years(ndgain_vuln_long[is.finite(ndgain_vulnerability), year], 'NDGAIN_vulnerability'),
  check_source_years(ndgain_readiness_long[is.finite(ndgain_readiness), year], 'NDGAIN_readiness')
))
fwrite(source_year_coverage, file.path(diagnostics_dir, 'source_year_coverage.csv'))
if (any(!source_year_coverage$present)) {
  stop('The requested period includes years unavailable in at least one input source. ',
       'See source_year_coverage.csv. Change the year settings or provide the missing inputs; ',
       'the workflow will not silently shorten your period or invent data.')
}
assert_unique(ndgain_vuln_long, c('iso3c','year'), 'NDGAIN_vulnerability')
assert_unique(ndgain_readiness_long, c('iso3c','year'), 'NDGAIN_readiness')

ndgain_vuln_long <- ndgain_vuln_long[year >= analysis_start_year & year <= analysis_end_year]
ndgain_readiness_long <- ndgain_readiness_long[year >= analysis_start_year & year <= analysis_end_year]

ndgain_long <- merge(
  ndgain_vuln_long,
  ndgain_readiness_long[, .(iso3c, year, ndgain_readiness)],
  by = c('iso3c', 'year'),
  all = TRUE
)

# ndgain_vulnerability contains the ND-GAIN country-year
# overall vulnerability score.

# Reverse-code readiness as (1 - readiness) so that both terms
# have the same risk direction: higher values indicate greater risk.
ndgain_long[, ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness := fifelse(
  !is.na(ndgain_vulnerability) & !is.na(ndgain_readiness),
  (combined_ndgain_weights['vulnerability'] * ndgain_vulnerability) +
    (combined_ndgain_weights['readiness_risk'] * (1 - ndgain_readiness)),
  NA_real_
)]

# ============================================================
# SECTION 11. MERGE ND-GAIN EXPORTER-RISK DATA ONTO COUNTRY-SPECIES-YEAR IMPORT TABLE
# ============================================================
trade_country_species_year_nd <- copy(trade_country_species_year)[year >= analysis_start_year & year <= analysis_end_year]

trade_country_species_year_risk <- merge(
  trade_country_species_year_nd,
  ndgain_long,
  by = c('iso3c', 'year'),
  all.x = TRUE
)

ndgain_unmatched_countries <- unique(
  trade_country_species_year_risk[is.na(ndgain_vulnerability), .(iso3c, country_name)]
)[order(country_name)]

ndgain_readiness_unmatched_countries <- unique(
  trade_country_species_year_risk[is.na(ndgain_readiness), .(iso3c, country_name)]
)[order(country_name)]

ndgain_combined_unmatched_countries <- unique(
  trade_country_species_year_risk[is.na(ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness), .(iso3c, country_name)]
)[order(country_name)]

trade_country_species_year_risk <- merge(
  trade_country_species_year_risk,
  trade_species_year_imports[year >= analysis_start_year & year <= analysis_end_year],
  by = c('year', 'species_group'),
  suffixes = c('', '_species_total'),
  all.x = TRUE
)

setnames(
  trade_country_species_year_risk,
  old = c('import_volume_kg_species_total', 'import_value_usd_species_total'),
  new = c('species_import_volume_kg', 'species_import_value_usd')
)

# ============================================================
# SECTION 12. COMPUTE IMPORT SHARES AND SUPPLIER CONCENTRATION
# ============================================================
trade_country_species_year_risk[, import_share_volume := fifelse(
  !is.na(species_import_volume_kg) & species_import_volume_kg > 0,
  import_volume_kg / species_import_volume_kg,
  NA_real_
)]

trade_country_species_year_risk[, import_share_value := fifelse(
  !is.na(species_import_value_usd) & species_import_value_usd > 0,
  import_value_usd / species_import_value_usd,
  NA_real_
)]

supplier_concentration <- trade_country_species_year_risk[
  ,
  .(
    supplier_hhi_volume = sum(import_share_volume^2, na.rm = TRUE),
    supplier_hhi_value = sum(import_share_value^2, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_suppliers = uniqueN(iso3c[!is.na(import_share_volume) & import_share_volume > 0])
  ),
  by = .(year, species_group)
]

# ============================================================
# SECTION 13. COMPUTE WEIGHTED EXPORTER RISK
# ============================================================
exporter_risk_species_year_raw <- trade_country_species_year_risk[
  ,
  .(
    weighted_ndgain_vulnerability_volume_raw = sum(import_share_volume * ndgain_vulnerability, na.rm = TRUE),
    weighted_ndgain_vulnerability_value_raw = sum(import_share_value * ndgain_vulnerability, na.rm = TRUE),
    weighted_ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness_volume_raw = sum(import_share_volume * ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness, na.rm = TRUE),
    weighted_ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness_value_raw = sum(import_share_value * ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness, na.rm = TRUE),

    share_with_ndgain_vulnerability = sum(import_share_volume[!is.na(ndgain_vulnerability)], na.rm = TRUE),
    share_with_ndgain_vulnerability_value = sum(import_share_value[!is.na(ndgain_vulnerability)], na.rm = TRUE),
    share_with_ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness = sum(import_share_volume[!is.na(ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness)], na.rm = TRUE),
    share_with_ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness_value = sum(import_share_value[!is.na(ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness)], na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = .(year, species_group)
]

exporter_risk_species_year <- copy(exporter_risk_species_year_raw)

exporter_risk_species_year[, weighted_ndgain_vulnerability_volume := fifelse(
  share_with_ndgain_vulnerability > 0,
  weighted_ndgain_vulnerability_volume_raw / share_with_ndgain_vulnerability,
  NA_real_
)]
exporter_risk_species_year[, weighted_ndgain_vulnerability_value := fifelse(
  share_with_ndgain_vulnerability_value > 0,
  weighted_ndgain_vulnerability_value_raw / share_with_ndgain_vulnerability_value,
  NA_real_
)]

exporter_risk_species_year[, weighted_ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness_volume := fifelse(
  share_with_ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness > 0,
  weighted_ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness_volume_raw / share_with_ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness,
  NA_real_
)]
exporter_risk_species_year[, weighted_ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness_value := fifelse(
  share_with_ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness_value > 0,
  weighted_ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness_value_raw / share_with_ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness_value,
  NA_real_
)]

exporter_metric_map <- list(
  ndgain_vulnerability = list(
    volume = 'weighted_ndgain_vulnerability_volume',
    value = 'weighted_ndgain_vulnerability_value',
    share_volume = 'share_with_ndgain_vulnerability',
    share_value = 'share_with_ndgain_vulnerability_value'
  ),
  ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness = list(
    volume = 'weighted_ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness_volume',
    value = 'weighted_ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness_value',
    share_volume = 'share_with_ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness',
    share_value = 'share_with_ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness_value'
  )
)

primary_metric_cols <- exporter_metric_map[[primary_exporter_metric]]
secondary_metric_cols <- exporter_metric_map[[secondary_exporter_metric]]

exporter_risk_species_year[, exporter_metric_primary := primary_exporter_metric]
exporter_risk_species_year[, exporter_metric_secondary := secondary_exporter_metric]

exporter_risk_species_year[, weighted_exporter_risk_volume := get(primary_metric_cols$volume)]
exporter_risk_species_year[, weighted_exporter_risk_value := get(primary_metric_cols$value)]
exporter_risk_species_year[, share_with_exporter_risk := get(primary_metric_cols$share_volume)]
exporter_risk_species_year[, share_with_exporter_risk_value := get(primary_metric_cols$share_value)]

exporter_risk_species_year[, weighted_secondary_exporter_risk_volume := get(secondary_metric_cols$volume)]
exporter_risk_species_year[, weighted_secondary_exporter_risk_value := get(secondary_metric_cols$value)]
exporter_risk_species_year[, share_with_secondary_exporter_risk := get(secondary_metric_cols$share_volume)]
exporter_risk_species_year[, share_with_secondary_exporter_risk_value := get(secondary_metric_cols$share_value)]

# ============================================================
# SECTION 14. COMPUTE EXPORT-ADJUSTED IMPORT DEPENDENCE
# ============================================================
domestic_species_year_nd <- copy(domestic_species_year)[year >= analysis_start_year & year <= analysis_end_year]

species_year_base <- Reduce(
  function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = c('year', 'species_group'), all = TRUE),
  list(
    trade_species_year_imports[year >= analysis_start_year & year <= analysis_end_year],
    trade_species_year_exports[year >= analysis_start_year & year <= analysis_end_year],
    domestic_species_year_nd[, .(year, species_group, domestic_kg, domestic_value_usd)]
  )
)

species_year_base[is.na(import_volume_kg), import_volume_kg := 0]
species_year_base[is.na(import_value_usd), import_value_usd := 0]
species_year_base[is.na(export_volume_kg), export_volume_kg := 0]
species_year_base[is.na(export_value_usd), export_value_usd := 0]
species_year_base[is.na(domestic_kg), domestic_kg := 0]
species_year_base[is.na(domestic_value_usd), domestic_value_usd := 0]

species_year_base[, domestic_available_kg := pmax(domestic_kg - export_volume_kg, 0)]
species_year_base[, domestic_available_value := pmax(domestic_value_usd - export_value_usd, 0)]

species_year_base[, import_dependence_volume := fifelse(
  (import_volume_kg + domestic_available_kg) > 0,
  import_volume_kg / (import_volume_kg + domestic_available_kg),
  NA_real_
)]

species_year_base[, import_dependence_value := fifelse(
  (import_value_usd + domestic_available_value) > 0,
  import_value_usd / (import_value_usd + domestic_available_value),
  NA_real_
)]

species_year_base[, import_dependence_volume_simple := fifelse(
  (import_volume_kg + domestic_kg) > 0,
  import_volume_kg / (import_volume_kg + domestic_kg),
  NA_real_
)]

species_year_base[, self_reliance_volume := 1 - import_dependence_volume]

# SECTION 15. BUILD SPECIES-YEAR RISK INPUT TABLE
# ============================================================

  function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = c('year', 'species_group'), all = TRUE),

species_year_risk_inputs[, concentration_norm := minmax01(supplier_hhi_volume)]
species_year_risk_inputs[, exporter_risk_norm := minmax01(weighted_exporter_risk_volume)]
species_year_risk_inputs[, secondary_exporter_risk_norm := minmax01(weighted_secondary_exporter_risk_volume)]

  import_dependence_norm * concentration_norm * exporter_risk_norm
)^(1/3)]

species_year_risk_inputs[, seafood_dependency_risk_index_secondary := (
  import_dependence_norm * concentration_norm * secondary_exporter_risk_norm

)

             n_finite = sum(good),
             n_reference_groups = uniqueN(species_year_risk_inputs$species_group[good]),

}))

fwrite(unique(species_year_risk_inputs[, .(species_group)]),

assert_unique(species_year_risk_inputs, c('year','species_group'), 'species_year_risk_inputs')

fwrite(species_year_risk_inputs[, .(
  year, species_group, import_volume_kg, export_volume_kg, domestic_kg,
```

```{r generate-results}
minmax01 <- function(x) {
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(rng[1]) || !is.finite(rng[2]) || rng[1] == rng[2]) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  }
  (x - rng[1]) / (rng[2] - rng[1])
}

# =========================================================
# SECTION 7. TABLE F. TEMPORAL VARIABILITY
# =========================================================
calc_temporal_variability <- function(dt) {
  dt <- copy(dt)[order(year)]

  risk_vals <- dt$seafood_dependency_risk_index
  risk_vals_valid <- risk_vals[is.finite(risk_vals)]
  annual_changes <- abs(diff(risk_vals))
  consecutive <- diff(dt$year) == 1L
  annual_changes <- annual_changes[consecutive & is.finite(annual_changes)]

  component_sds <- c(
    import_dependence = sd(dt$import_dependence_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    supplier_concentration = sd(dt$concentration_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    exporter_risk = sd(dt$exporter_risk_norm, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  component_sds[is.nan(component_sds)] <- NA_real_
  dominant_component <- if (all(is.na(component_sds))) {
    NA_character_
  } else {
    names(component_sds)[which.max(ifelse(is.na(component_sds), -Inf, component_sds))]
  }

  mean_risk <- if (length(risk_vals_valid) > 0) mean(risk_vals_valid) else NA_real_
  sd_risk <- if (length(risk_vals_valid) > 1) sd(risk_vals_valid) else NA_real_
  min_risk <- if (length(risk_vals_valid) > 0) min(risk_vals_valid) else NA_real_
  max_risk <- if (length(risk_vals_valid) > 0) max(risk_vals_valid) else NA_real_

  data.table(
    species_label = dt$species_label[1],
    mean_risk = mean_risk,
    sd_risk = sd_risk,
    cv_risk = fifelse(!is.na(mean_risk) & mean_risk > 0, sd_risk / mean_risk, NA_real_),
    min_risk = min_risk,
    max_risk = max_risk,
    range_risk = fifelse(!is.na(max_risk) & !is.na(min_risk), max_risk - min_risk, NA_real_),
    mean_abs_annual_change = if (length(annual_changes) > 0) mean(annual_changes) else NA_real_,
    max_abs_annual_change = if (length(annual_changes) > 0) max(annual_changes) else NA_real_,
    sd_import_dependence = sd(dt$import_dependence_volume, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_supplier_concentration_hhi = sd(dt$supplier_hhi_volume, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_exporter_risk = sd(dt$weighted_exporter_risk_volume, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_import_dependence_norm = component_sds['import_dependence'],
    sd_supplier_concentration_norm = component_sds['supplier_concentration'],
    sd_exporter_risk_norm = component_sds['exporter_risk'],
    dominant_variable_component = dominant_component,
    n_years = nrow(dt)
  )
}
```

# Generate supplementary tables and internal checks

```{r supplementary-and-checks}
# Generate supplementary tables and internal checks

# ============================================================
# SECTION 1. INPUTS AND SCORING HELPERS
# ============================================================
if (!exists('species_main') || !exists('trade_country_species_year_risk') ||
    !exists('normalization_reference')) {
  stop('Run prepare-inputs and generate-results first.')
}
primary_country_column <- if (primary_exporter_metric == 'ndgain_vulnerability') {
  'ndgain_vulnerability'
} else 'ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness'
secondary_country_column <- if (secondary_exporter_metric == 'ndgain_vulnerability') {
  'ndgain_vulnerability'
} else 'ndgain_combined_vuln_readiness'

source_detail <- copy(trade_country_species_year_risk)[
  species_group %in% main_species & is.finite(import_volume_kg) & import_volume_kg > 0
]
source_detail[, species_label := pretty_species[species_group]]
source_detail[, primary_country_risk := get(primary_country_column)]
source_detail[, reported_source_id := paste(
  fifelse(is.na(iso3c), 'UNMAPPED', iso3c), country_name, sep = ' | '
)]
assert_unique(source_detail, c('year','species_group','reported_source_id'), 'source_detail')
setorder(source_detail, year, species_group, -import_volume_kg, country_name)
source_detail[, supplier_order := seq_len(.N), by = .(year, species_group)]
fwrite(source_detail, file.path(source_profile_checks_dir, 'Source_country_species_year_detail.csv'))

score_on_fixed_reference <- function(id, hhi, er) {
  raw <- c(import_dependence_volume = id, supplier_hhi_volume = hhi,
           weighted_exporter_risk_volume = er)
  rr <- normalization_reference[match(names(raw), input_column)]
  z <- (raw - rr$minimum) / (rr$maximum - rr$minimum)
  names(z) <- c('ID_normalized','HHI_normalized','ER_normalized')
  valid <- all(is.finite(z))
  in_range <- valid && all(z >= -1e-10 & z <= 1 + 1e-10)
  score <- if (in_range) prod(pmin(pmax(z, 0), 1))^(1/3) else NA_real_
  list(score = score, z = z, valid = valid, in_range = in_range)
}

# ============================================================
# SECTION 2. TABLE G. REPORTED SOURCE-COUNTRY PROFILES
# ============================================================
source_profile_annual <- source_detail[, {
  v <- import_volume_kg
  sh <- v / sum(v)
  top <- which.max(v)
  known <- is.finite(primary_country_risk)
  cov <- sum(sh[known])
  list(
    total_import_volume_kg = sum(v),
    largest_reported_source = country_name[top],
    largest_source_iso3c = iso3c[top],
    largest_source_share = sh[top],
    largest_source_tie_count = sum(v == max(v)),
    top_three_share = sum(sort(sh, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(min(3L, .N))]),
    n_reported_sources = .N,
    n_mapped_ISO_codes = uniqueN(iso3c[!is.na(iso3c)]),
    hhi = sum(sh^2),
    exporter_risk_coverage = cov,
    import_weighted_exporter_risk = if (cov > 0) {
      sum(sh[known] * primary_country_risk[known]) / cov
    } else NA_real_
  )
}, by = .(year, species_group, species_label)]

source_profile_annual <- merge(
  source_profile_annual,
  species_main[, .(year, species_group,
                    import_dependence = import_dependence_volume,
                    us_sdri = seafood_dependency_risk_index)],
  by = c('year', 'species_group'), all.x = TRUE
)
setorder(source_profile_annual, year, -us_sdri)

source_profile_snapshot_full <- source_profile_annual[year == source_profile_year]
source_profile_snapshot <- source_profile_snapshot_full[, .(
  year,
  species_group,
  species_label,
  largest_reported_source,
  largest_source_share,
  top_three_share,
  n_reported_sources,
  hhi,
  exporter_risk_coverage,
  import_dependence,
  us_sdri
)]
setorder(source_profile_snapshot, -us_sdri)

fwrite(source_profile_snapshot,
       file.path(results_table_dir, 'Table_G_source_country_profiles.csv'))
fwrite(source_profile_annual,
       file.path(source_profile_checks_dir, 'Source_country_profiles_all_selected_years.csv'))

source_profile_period <- source_profile_annual[, .(
  n_years = uniqueN(year),
  mean_annual_largest_source_share = mean_finite(largest_source_share),
  mean_annual_top_three_share = mean_finite(top_three_share),
  mean_annual_n_reported_sources = mean_finite(n_reported_sources),
  mean_annual_hhi = mean_finite(hhi),
  mean_annual_exporter_risk_coverage = mean_finite(exporter_risk_coverage)
), by = .(species_group, species_label)]
fwrite(source_profile_period,
       file.path(source_profile_checks_dir, 'Source_country_profiles_period_means.csv'))

# ============================================================
# SECTION 3. RANKING COMPARISON SUMMARY
# ============================================================
rank_comparison <- copy(supp_table_rank_change)
rank_comparison <- merge(
  rank_comparison,
  species_rank_mean[, .(species_group, mean_import_dependence)],
  by = 'species_group', all.x = TRUE
)
rank_comparison[, rank_import_dependence :=
                  frank(-mean_import_dependence, ties.method = 'min', na.last = 'keep')]
setorder(rank_comparison, -abs_rank_change, rank_risk)

valid_ranks <- rank_comparison[is.finite(rank_risk) & is.finite(rank_import_dependence)]
rank_summary <- data.table(
  statistic = c('n_groups_compared', 'n_groups_changing_rank',
                'mean_absolute_rank_change', 'max_absolute_rank_change',
                'spearman_rank_correlation_descriptive'),
  value = c(
    nrow(valid_ranks),
    sum(valid_ranks$rank_risk != valid_ranks$rank_import_dependence),
    mean_finite(abs(valid_ranks$rank_risk - valid_ranks$rank_import_dependence)),
    max_abs_finite(valid_ranks$rank_risk - valid_ranks$rank_import_dependence),
    if (nrow(valid_ranks) > 2L && uniqueN(valid_ranks$rank_risk) > 1L &&
        uniqueN(valid_ranks$rank_import_dependence) > 1L) {
      cor(valid_ranks$rank_risk, valid_ranks$rank_import_dependence, method = 'spearman')
    } else NA_real_
  )
)
fwrite(rank_comparison,
       file.path(ranking_checks_dir, 'Ranking_comparison_detail.csv'))
fwrite(rank_summary,
       file.path(ranking_checks_dir, 'Ranking_comparison_summary.csv'))

# ============================================================
# SECTION 4. TABLE H. ILLUSTRATIVE SOURCING REALLOCATION
# ============================================================
scenario_rows <- list()
scenario_country_rows <- list()

for (sg in main_species) {
  d <- copy(source_detail[year == scenario_year & species_group == sg])
  base <- species_main[year == scenario_year & species_group == sg]
  basic <- data.table(
    species_group = sg,
    species_label = pretty_species[sg],
    year = scenario_year,
    fraction_of_largest_supplier_volume = scenario_reallocation_fraction
  )
  if (!nrow(d) || nrow(base) != 1L) {
    basic[, status := 'not_evaluated_no_imports_or_no_species_year']
    scenario_rows[[sg]] <- basic
    next
  }
  setorder(d, -import_volume_kg, country_name)
  old_v <- d$import_volume_kg
  total <- sum(old_v)
  other_total <- total - old_v[1]
  if (nrow(d) < 2L || other_total <= 0) {
    basic[, `:=`(
      status = 'not_evaluated_no_existing_alternative_supplier',
      largest_reported_source = d$country_name[1]
    )]
    scenario_rows[[sg]] <- basic
    next
  }

  transfer <- scenario_reallocation_fraction * old_v[1]
  new_v <- old_v
  new_v[1] <- old_v[1] - transfer
  new_v[-1] <- old_v[-1] + transfer * old_v[-1] / other_total
  if (abs(sum(new_v) - total) > 1e-8 * max(1, total) || any(new_v < 0)) {
    stop('Scenario failed the fixed-total/nonnegative-volume check for ', sg)
  }

  p0 <- old_v / total
  p1 <- new_v / total
  known <- is.finite(d$primary_country_risk)
  c0 <- sum(p0[known])
  c1 <- sum(p1[known])
  er0 <- if (c0 > 0) sum(p0[known] * d$primary_country_risk[known]) / c0 else NA_real_
  er1 <- if (c1 > 0) sum(p1[known] * d$primary_country_risk[known]) / c1 else NA_real_
  h0 <- sum(p0^2)
  h1 <- sum(p1^2)
  id <- base$import_dependence_volume[1]
  score0 <- score_on_fixed_reference(id, h0, er0)
  score1 <- score_on_fixed_reference(id, h1, er1)

  if (is.finite(base$supplier_hhi_volume) && abs(h0 - base$supplier_hhi_volume) > 1e-8) {
    stop('Scenario baseline HHI does not reproduce the main panel for ', sg)
  }
  if (is.finite(er0) && is.finite(base$weighted_exporter_risk_volume) &&
      abs(er0 - base$weighted_exporter_risk_volume) > 1e-8) {
    stop('Scenario baseline exporter risk does not reproduce the main panel for ', sg)
  }
  if (is.finite(score0$score) && is.finite(base$seafood_dependency_risk_index) &&
      abs(score0$score - base$seafood_dependency_risk_index) > 1e-8) {
    stop('Scenario baseline index does not reproduce the main panel for ', sg)
  }

  status <- if (!score1$valid) {
    'not_scored_missing_component_or_constant_reference'
  } else if (!score1$in_range) {
    'not_scored_outside_fixed_normalization_reference'
  } else {
    'evaluated'
  }

  basic[, `:=`(
    status = status,
    largest_reported_source = d$country_name[1],
    largest_source_share_before = p0[1],
    largest_source_share_after = p1[1],
    import_dependence_held_fixed = id,
    hhi_before = h0,
    hhi_after = h1,
    exporter_risk_before = er0,
    exporter_risk_after = er1,
    exporter_risk_coverage_before = c0,
    exporter_risk_coverage_after = c1,
    us_sdri_before = score0$score,
    us_sdri_after = score1$score,
    us_sdri_change = score1$score - score0$score
  )]
  scenario_rows[[sg]] <- basic

  d[, `:=`(
    import_volume_before = old_v,
    import_volume_after = new_v,
    share_before = p0,
    share_after = p1
  )]
  scenario_country_rows[[sg]] <- d[, .(
    year, species_group, species_label, reported_source_id, iso3c, country_name,
    primary_country_risk, import_volume_before, import_volume_after,
    share_before, share_after
  )]
}

scenario_results <- rbindlist(scenario_rows, fill = TRUE)
fwrite(scenario_results,
       file.path(scenario_checks_dir, 'Illustrative_sourcing_scenario_all_core_groups.csv'))
if (length(scenario_country_rows)) {

    hhi_after,
    exporter_risk_before,
    exporter_risk_after,
    us_sdri_before,
    us_sdri_after,
    us_sdri_change
  )
]

    paste0('Mean component values and U.S.-SDRI by seafood group, ', analysis_start_year, '–', analysis_end_year, '.'),
```
